# Synthetic Broker Flow fixtures

`SYNTHETIC-offline-v1.csv` is an invented platform interchange report. It is not
an official TWSE, TPEx or vendor report and is not evidence of usage rights,
verified broker identities, publication time or actual trading activity.

Tests encode the same fixed text as UTF-8/BOM and Big5, or package it in ordinary
ZIP files entirely in memory. No downloaded executable or self-extracting file
is executed, and these fixtures are never imported into the application DB.
